name: Faradars (فرادرس)
founded: ~2013-14 ('over a decade'; exact year not stated)
note: Homepage fetched 2026-10-01 mentions no AI assistant/tutor feature; a search-engine summary alleging one was not supported. Sells AI courses, does not (as far as found) ship AI tutoring. Third-party figure 4.5M students/16,000 titles is older.

name: Maktabkhooneh (مکتب‌خونه)
note: Its AI-in-education blog is generic and cites foreign market forecasts; no proprietary AI tutor or user count published there. Hosts Sharif/Tehran lecture courses (secondary). Revenue is an unverified aggregator figure.

name: Shad (شاد) - national school LMS

evidence.study: Reported criticism: low quality, did not compensate for in-person teaching; 13% of students lacked a device

privacy_note: State-run (Ministry of Education + Mobile Telecommunication Company of Iran); national, domestically hosted; no AI features documented in the source.
note: Wikipedia only; primary figures not checked.

name: Andarz (اندرز)

ai_features.name: Andi assistant
ai_features.what: answers subject questions by text/image/voice, step-by-step explanations; paired with human tutors; grades elementary to vocational

note: Company Houshyand Andisheshan Ofog Danesh, CEO Amin Amini (Sharif IE graduate); claims Ministry of Education content credential no. 4120. Promotional press; no users, funding or evaluation found. Also mentioned in Sharq Daily and Hamshahri.

name: Kanoon Ghalamchi (کانون قلم‌چی) - AI major-selection tool

ai_features.name: AI field-selection system for Konkur 1404 (experimental sciences)
ai_features.what: recommends majors/locations from real exam data; built with top rankers and the agency Digitalogy AI; discounted 90% for Kanoon students

note: Item on kanoon.ir is a promotion of a Digitalogy product; no evidence it is Kanoon's own AI tutor. A claim that Kanoon's student page is an 'intelligent assistant LMS' came from a search snippet only.

name: Iran Digital / Ministry of Education AI literacy programme

ai_features.name: AI literacy courses on two platforms
ai_features.what: free AI training for students and teachers, tiered 200k -> 20k -> 2k -> festival of 1,000

privacy_note: state programme; no data terms found
note: Teaches about AI, not AI tutoring. Official-aligned press; figures are targets/announcements, no independent count. Counts vary across outlets (210k vs 260k vs 280k teachers).

name: MSRT national AI action plan (universities)

scale.metric: planned national AI labs / fundamental models
scale.value: 5 national labs (another report: 15 labs); at least 3 fundamental models

privacy_note: plans a secure research/education data-sharing platform

name: University LMS (Navid, Moodle-based systems)
note: Navid is the medical-sciences national LMS (Virtual University of Medical Sciences, per search summary). IUST, Isfahan, Iran UMS run in-house LMS portals. No AI features found on the landing/help pages seen; contents of LMS not inspected.

name: Local/Persian LLMs and access constraints

ai_features.name: PersianMind, Dorna, Ava (Llama-based Persian models)
ai_features.what: open Persian-capable models used because OpenAI/Anthropic do not serve Iranian IPs

privacy_note: OpenAI blocks Iran IPs (OFAC sanctions); the state also filters foreign AI. Users rely on VPNs (secondary sources).
note: Sanctions claims from VPN-vendor and forum pages (weak); PersianMind paper is peer-reviewable arXiv. No education deployment of these models found.
